statement: Median cloud rental price for an Nvidia H100 80GB is $2.97 per GPU-hour across listed providers.
why: A cross-provider median rental level is a reference point for what buyers currently pay for prior-generation training and inference capacity.

impact.mechanism: Rental price is a display level only; with no baseline or change stated it does not indicate whether demand or supply is tightening.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia H100 | 80GB HBM3 | $2.97 /hr median | Vast.ai, GPU.ai, UpCloud

confidence.basis: Single secondary aggregator page; methodology behind the median is not disclosed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 1.59 -> 2.97 (tol 1%); sources: GetDeploying cloud GPU price reference
